### `create_chat_channel`

**Create a Channel** · `POST /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/chat/channels` · API v3 · 🟡 write

This endpoint creates a new Channel not tied to a Space, Folder, or List. If a Channel with the specified name already exists it returns it.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | integer | yes | The ID of the Workspace. |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

<details>
<summary><code>body</code> fields (5)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | string |  | The description for the Chat being created. |
| `name` | string | yes | The name for the Chat being created. |
| `topic` | string |  | The topic of the Chat being created. |
| `user_ids[]` | string[] |  | Optionally specify unique user IDs, up to 100. |
| `visibility` | `"PUBLIC"` \| `"PRIVATE"` |  | The visibility of the Chat being created. If not specified, the Chat is PUBLIC. |

</details>

### `create_chat_reaction`

**Create a message reaction** · `POST /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/chat/messages/{message_id}/reactions` · API v3 · 🟡 write

<summary><code>body</code> fields (1)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reaction` | string | yes | The name of the emoji to use for the reaction. |

</details>

### `create_direct_message_channel`

**Create a Direct Message** · `POST /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/chat/channels/direct_message` · API v3 · 🟡 write

This endpoint creates a new Direct Message between up to 15 users. If a Direct Message between those users already exists it returns it.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | integer | yes | The ID of the Workspace. |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

<details>
<summary><code>body</code> fields (1)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `user_ids[]` | string[] |  | The unique user IDs of participants in the direct message Chat, up to 15. A Self DM is created when no user IDs are provided |

</details>

### `create_location_chat_channel`

**Create a Channel on a Space, Folder, or List** · `POST /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/chat/channels/location` · API v3 · 🟡 write

This endpoint creates a Channel on a Space, Folder, or List. When a Channel already exists on the requested location, it returns it.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | integer | yes | The ID of the Workspace. |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

<details>
<summary><code>body</code> fields (7)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | string |  | The description for the Chat being created. |
| `topic` | string |  | The topic of the Chat being created. |
| `user_ids[]` | string[] |  | Optionally specify unique user IDs, up to 100. |
| `visibility` | `"PUBLIC"` \| `"PRIVATE"` |  | The visibility of the Chat being created. If not specified, the Chat is PUBLIC. |
| `location` | object | yes | The location of the chat: space, folder, or list |
| `location.id` | string | yes | The ID of the hierarchy entity where the chat is to be located |

### `get_chat_channels`

**Retrieve Channels** · `GET /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/chat/channels` · API v3 · 🟢 read-only

This endpoint retrieves the Channels in a Workspace.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | integer | yes | The ID of the Workspace. |
| `description_format` | query | `"text/md"` \| `"text/plain"` |  | Format of the Channel description (Default: text/md). |
| `cursor` | query | string |  | Used to request the next page of results. |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | The maximum number of results to fetch for this page. (default `50`, ≥ 1, ≤ 100) |
| `is_follower` | query | boolean |  | Only return Channels the user is following. (default `false`) |
| `include_closed` | query | boolean |  | Include DMs/Group DMs that have been explicitly closed. (default `false`) |
| `with_message_since` | query | number |  | Only return Channels with at least one message since the given timestamp. |
| `channel_types` | query | any |  | Specify the types of Channels to return from the request. |
